prompt: pulumi fully_qualified_stack_name diy backend org requirement
answer:
For a DIY backend:

- **Non-legacy/project-scoped DIY backends:** use the fully qualified format:
  ```text
  organization/<project>/<stack>
  ```
  The organization component must always be the literal value **`organization`**; it cannot be changed.

- **Legacy DIY backends:** fully qualified names are not supported. Use only:
  ```text
  <stack>
  ```

Project-scoped DIY stacks are supported starting with Pulumi **v3.61.0**. Existing legacy backends must be upgraded with:

```bash
pulumi state upgrade
```

Sources: [Pulumi Stacks](https://www.pulumi.com/docs/iac/concepts/stacks/), [Aligning Projects between Service and DIY Backend](https://www.pulumi.com/blog/project-scoped-stacks-in-self-managed-backend/), [fullyQualifiedStackName](https://www.pulumi.com/docs/reference/pkg/nodejs/pulumi/pulumi/functions/automation.fullyQualifiedStackName.html)
